title: BetterVanilla SMP ModPack

body:
# BetterVanilla SMP Modpack

## Overview

**BetterVanilla SMP Modpack** enhances vanilla Minecraft with better performance, useful quality-of-life features, and optional visual upgrades.

It is made for private SMP servers and friend groups who want a smooth, stable, long-term survival experience without changing core gameplay.

Just Minecraft - but better.

## 🔗 Recommended Server Plugin

For the best experience, this modpack is recommended to be used together with the **BetterVanilla SMP** server plugin:

https://modrinth.com/plugin/bettervanilla-smp

The plugin adds server-side features that perfectly complement this modpack for private SMP servers.

## 🎯 Goal

The goal of this modpack is simple:

> Make vanilla Minecraft run better and feel smoother in multiplayer.

No progression systems. No overhauls. No gameplay changes.

## ⚙️ Features

- Improved FPS and reduced lag
- Lower memory usage
- Helpful inventory and UI improvements
- Optional shader support
- Multiplayer-friendly setup

## ❤️ Credits

All mods belong to their respective authors.

## 🏁 Final

This pack is for players who love vanilla Minecraft and just want it to run better.
